svg.title: Aspect ratio and annular ring
svg.desc: Left: a cross-section of a 1.6 mm board with a 0.2 mm drilled hole, an aspect ratio of 8 to 1, the recommended limit. Right: top views of a 0.6 mm pad on a 0.3 mm hole. Centered, the copper ring around the hole, the annular ring, is 0.15 mm all round. With the drill 0.1 mm off center, the ring is only 0.05 mm on one side: still inside the pad, which is what the margin is for.

g.text: Drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm.
Aspect ratio: 8:1 or less is recommended, and 10:1 at most (PCB-DFM-024).
Annular ring: design 0.15 mm on outer layers. IPC Class 3 needs 50 µm on the finished board (PCB-DFM-026).
